title: The Inverse Galois Problem
exact_target: Can every finite group occur as the Galois group of a finite extension of the rational numbers?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1191 (ALG-027). CC BY 4.0.

Alexander Schmidt and Kay Wingberg, \emph{Safarevic's theorem on solvable groups as Galois groups}, arXiv:math/9809211 (1998), introduction and Section 1, including the general inverse problem distinguished from the solvable-group theorem.
